description: This file implements revocation checking logic for certificates, including OCSP and CRL checks, within the Chromium project. It contains functions for verifying revocation status, handling network fetches for OCSP/CRL responses, and integrating with CRLSet revocation data.

methods.name: MarkCertificateRevoked
methods.description: Marks a certificate as revoked by adding an error to the provided CertErrors object.

methods.name: CheckCertRevocation
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a specific certificate in a chain, using OCSP and CRL, according to the provided policy and network fetcher.

methods.name: CheckValidatedChainRevocation
methods.description: Iterates over a chain of certificates to verify their revocation status, from root to leaf, using OCSP/CRL and updating errors.

methods.name: CheckChainRevocationUsingCRLSet
methods.description: Checks revocation status of a certificate chain against a CRLSet, considering SPKI, subject, and serial number revocations.
